Q041-02.notes: slope (-1-5)/3=-2, f(x)=-2x+7; -2x+7=x -> x=7/3. Distractors: 7 = intercept, 7/2 = zero of f, -7/3 sign error; all plausible.

Q041-03.notes: d=q+5, 0.25q - 0.10d = 1.30 -> 15q=180, q=12, d=17. Trap: reporting quarters (12) or reversing the value difference.

Q041-04.notes: (k-4)/2 = (2k-k)/4 -> 2k-8=k -> k=8; f(x)=2x+2 gives 4, 8, 16. D (16)=2k is a value-confusion distractor; reasonable.

flags: minor: classic textbook rational-equation word problem (well-worn template, not a specific official SAT item)
minor: 'could buy 2 more shirts' implicitly assumes 120 is divisible by both prices; true for p=20 (6 vs 8 shirts)
Q041-05.notes: 120/(p-5) - 120/p = 2 -> p^2-5p-300=0 -> (p-20)(p+15)=0 -> p=20. Requires setting up rational equation; guess-and-check possible but no choices to test.

Q041-06.notes: 1/x+1/y=(x+y)/(xy); reciprocal = xy/(x+y). D is the unreciprocated sum, B is the naive exponent-distribution error. Plug-in numbers works.

Q041-07.notes: 2^(2x)=8 -> x=3/2, b=2^(3/2)=2sqrt2 ~2.83. Graphing gives intersection (1.5, 2.83) directly. Distractors 4/8/sqrt2 plausible-ish.

Q041-08.notes: Let t=x-1: f(t)=(t+1)^2+2(t+1)=t^2+4t+3. A = wrong-direction substitution (x-1), B = (x+1)^2 trap; check f(-1)=0 rules out C only, so plug-in needs two points.

flags: minor: symmetric frequency tables make equal means visible at a glance; standard-deviation comparison by inspection is a very common official SAT item type
Q041-09.notes: Both symmetric about 3, mean 3. Set B concentrated at extremes 1 and 5 -> larger SD.

Q041-10.notes: V=1000/2.7=370.37 cm^3; edge = cube root = 7.18 -> 7.2. Traps: forgetting kg->g (edge 0.7) or multiplying by density.

flags: minor: radius (5) is not needed; (1,3) verified on circle so item is consistent
Q041-11.notes: Complete squares: (x-4)^2+(y+1)^2=25, center (4,-1). Other endpoint = 2*center - (1,3) = (7,-5). B is the center (good distractor); A from wrong signs.

Q041-12.notes: Arc = 2r, perimeter 2r+2r=4r=36 -> r=9; area = (1/2)r^2*theta = 81 (or (2/(2pi))*pi*81). Trap: ignoring the radii (r=18 -> 324). In domain (radians/arc length).
